export_graphviz_export_tree: export a fitted decision tree to Graphviz DOT format with feature and class names
export_graphviz_with_options: export a decision tree to Graphviz with filled nodes, proportions, rounded corners, and custom font
export_graphviz_max_depth: export a decision tree truncated at a max depth with node ids and filled colors
export_text_display_tree: export a fitted decision tree as human-readable text with feature and class names
plot_tree_render_tree: plot a fitted decision tree with matplotlib using feature names and fontsize
